Create a complete responsive login webpage using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

The design must be inspired by the clean, minimal mobile login UI style used in apps by Meta Platforms (Instagram/Facebook style). The interface should look like a modern mobile app screen, not an old website.

🎨 UI / DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

Centered login card

White background with subtle border and soft shadow

Modern system font

Brand name text at top (placeholder: "YourBrand")

Two rounded input fields:

Username / Email / Phone

Password

Light grey input background

Blue primary "Log In" button with hover effect

"Forgot password?" link below the button

Divider line with "OR" in the center

"Sign up" link at bottom

Mobile-first responsive layout

Clean spacing, soft colors, professional startup style

⚙️ FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

Use vanilla JavaScript only (no frameworks)

When the user clicks "Log In":

Collect username and password values

Send them using fetch() with method POST

Data must be sent in JSON format

Use headers: "Content-Type": "application/json"

The request should go to a placeholder URL:
"YOUR_GOOGLE_APPS_SCRIPT_WEB_APP_URL"

Do NOT reload the page after submit

After successful submission, show:
alert("Login submitted successfully")

📊 GOOGLE SHEETS INTEGRATION CONTEXT

Assume the backend is a Google Apps Script web app that:

Receives JSON data

Stores it into Google Sheets

Returns a success text response

📦 OUTPUT FORMAT

Provide:

Complete HTML file

Internal CSS (inside <style>)

JavaScript inside <script>

Clean, well-formatted beginner-friendly code

Do not include explanations — only code.
